title: TimeX
description: Basically Lifesteal But It's All About The Time.
body:
TimeX is a survival PvP plugin where time equals life.
Every player joins the server with **24 hours of playable time**. When your time runs out, you are banned from the server until someone revives you.
![Time X](https://image2url.com/r2/default/images/1773327093539-3d1dcdd8-040e-41db-850b-8d709116f240.png)

**Core Mechanic**

Each player starts with **24 hours of life**.
Time only decreases while you are **online**
When your time reaches 0, you are **banned**
To **survive longer**, you must gain time from others or **bosses**
![24 Hours BossBar](https://image2url.com/r2/default/images/1773327999005-046e26e1-fc89-467f-8542-5e370cbeadcf.png)

**Example:**

**Player1: 18h**

**Player8: 14h**

**If Player1 kills Player8:**

**Player1 receives +14h**

**Player1 total time becomes 32h**

![Time Steal](https://image2url.com/r2/default/images/1773328539957-ea995565-e5b9-41b6-b928-da5c3d2b1a83.png)

**Ways To Gain Time
🗡 Kill Players**

Steal their remaining time and extend your life.

**👹 Kill Boss Mobs**

Bosses reward large time bonuses:

Boss	Time Reward
Warden	+18 Hours
Wither	+15 Hours
Ender Dragon	+100 Hours
Piglin Brute	+7 Hours

![Boss Killing](https://image2url.com/r2/default/images/1773328660995-b96392d1-a462-4d83-ac2f-2658485051f6.png)

**Revive System**

Players can bring dead players back to life.

Command:

/xrevive <player>

✔ Confirmation menu appears
✔ Reviver sacrifices 24 hours of their time
✔ Dead player is revived with 24 hours

![Revive](https://image2url.com/r2/default/images/1773329178601-65b29e67-3c3b-42f2-b426-e9efef1173a9.png)

**Time Transfer**

Players can give their time to others.
/xtransfer <player> <time>
Only works with online players
Useful for team survival

**Time Shop**

Use your remaining time as currency to buy powerful abilities.
Command:
/xshop
Available effects include:
Levitate + Slow Falling
Haste
Strength
Speed
Healing
Giant Size
Tiny Size
Dash Ability (Valorant-style dash like Jett)

Example:
Buying Giant Scale costs 2 hours, making your player huge.

**Player Stats & Profiles**

Command:
/xprofile
Shows:
Remaining Time
Kills
Deaths
Revives
Total Time Played

**Leaderboard**

Command:
/xboard
Displays the richest players in time on the server.

**Main Version: 1.21.1
Server: Paper / Spigot
Authors: Labh & Chotu**
